brief: Apply the previously taught financial relationships to the visible constraints of a new situation.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Revise and close a plan"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa y cierra un plan"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Revise e feche um plano"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Apply the previously taught financial relationships to the visible constraints of a new situation.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Reconcile changed costs, future commitments and actual movements without double counting.
instruction.misconception: Reuse an earlier answer without checking the current quantities, units and conditions.
instruction.numeracy_support: All required quantities remain on the current board.

evidence.reasoning: The added cost must appear in the revised total.
A sample share cannot override a verified necessary cost.
Borrowed cash adds an obligation that the plan must address.
A remainder alone does not establish an intentional feasible saving allocation.
Actual results report completed movements rather than forecasts.
A single award does not establish recurring receipts.
Occasional requests do not establish fixed recurring receipts.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

es-MX.line: Concilia costos cambiados, compromisos futuros y movimientos reales sin duplicar.

pt-BR.line: Concilie custos alterados, compromissos futuros e movimentos reais sem duplicar.

help: Remove the funded part before dividing what remains.

feedback.not_yet: Remove the funded part before dividing what remains.

en-US.scene: A required cost rises; current income and all other allocations are unchanged.

options.label: Show the increase and adjust feasibly

help: Maintain consistent amounts rather than hiding the change.

feedback.met: The added cost must appear in the revised total.
feedback.not_yet: Maintain consistent amounts rather than hiding the change.

es-MX.scene: Sube un costo necesario; ingreso y demás asignaciones no cambian.

options.label: Mostrar el aumento y ajustar de forma viable
Conservar el total anterior sin cambios

help: Conserva montos consistentes sin ocultar el cambio.

feedback.met: El costo adicional debe aparecer en el total revisado.
feedback.not_yet: Conserva montos consistentes sin ocultar el cambio.

pt-BR.prompt: O que o plano revisto deve fazer?

options.label: Mostrar o aumento e ajustar de forma viável

help: Mantenha valores consistentes sem esconder a mudança.

feedback.met: O custo adicional deve aparecer no total revisto.
feedback.not_yet: Mantenha valores consistentes sem esconder a mudança.

options.label: Assume actual housing costs are false

help: Use the guide while keeping the real obligation visible.

feedback.met: A sample share cannot override a verified necessary cost.
feedback.not_yet: Use the guide while keeping the real obligation visible.

help: Usa la guía conservando visible la obligación real.

feedback.met: Una parte de ejemplo no anula un costo necesario verificado.
feedback.not_yet: Usa la guía conservando visible la obligación real.

help: Check what must leave the budget later.

feedback.met: Borrowed cash adds an obligation that the plan must address.
feedback.not_yet: Check what must leave the budget later.

options.label: Costos y fechas de devolución en el plan
Una estimación de ingreso escrita mayor

help: Revisa qué deberá salir del presupuesto después.

feedback.met: El dinero prestado añade una obligación que el plan debe atender.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa qué deberá salir del presupuesto después.

pt-BR.prompt: O que falta antes de julgar viabilidade?

Uma estimativa escrita de renda maior

en-US.scene: Money remains; pending bills and a saving purpose are unchecked.

options.label: No, check obligations and allocate feasibly

help: Separate available, committed and deliberately allocated money.

feedback.met: A remainder alone does not establish an intentional feasible saving allocation.
feedback.not_yet: Separate available, committed and deliberately allocated money.

Sí, sin gastar siempre significa libre

feedback.met: Un resto por sí solo no demuestra ahorro intencional y viable.
feedback.not_yet: Distingue dinero disponible, comprometido y asignado deliberadamente.

pt-BR.scene: Resta dinheiro sem gastar, mas não conferiram contas pendentes nem definiram uma meta.

Sim, não gasto sempre significa livre

help: Distinga dinheiro disponível, comprometido e destinado deliberadamente.
